description: Semantic role map for the Seller's Disclosure Notice, TREC No. 55-1 (rev 05-04-2026; footer on every rendered page reads 'TREC No. 55-1' and the page-4 legal box says 'This form replaces 55-0' — the live asset IS the TREC 55-1 form, NOT TXR-1406). Coordinates extracted directly from the live AcroForm widget rects (pdf-lib), same method as api/_assets/trec-20-19-esign-coords.json. Roles/keys/questions derived from viewing the rendered numbered overlays (.tmp/coord-overlays/sellers-disclosure-page-*.png) against the real printed form text — NOT from the raw AcroForm field names, which are generic XFA names (TextField3[n], CheckBox1[0], ...). All answer fields (role 'deal') on this form are ANSWERED BY THE SELLER — this is a seller questionnaire; role 'deal' is kept for cross-form composability with the other role-maps. Single-character write-in answer boxes carry `allowed_values` (Y/N/U for Section 1 per its printed instruction, Y/N for Q3/Q4/Q6/Q9 per theirs). Mutually-exclusive checkbox sets (Yes/No/Unknown, Yes/No, wholly/partly, is/is-not occupying) carry `option_group`/`option_value` and are indexed in top-level `option_groups`. Buyers sign ONLY the page-4 receipt row ('The undersigned purchaser hereby acknowledges receipt of the foregoing notice.') — sellers sign the top row. x_pct/y_pct/w_pct/h_pct are top-left-origin PERCENTAGES 0-100 (matching scripts/extract-trec-field-coords.js convention; divide by 100 before feeding into DocuSeal areas[] which expects 0-1 fractions).
